title: prefill/decode: chunked speculative prefill + stage-overlap kernel scheduler optimizations
author: Asha Menon
description: Motivation: reduce tail latency and improve throughput for mixed prefill+decode workloads by overlapping prefill and decode pipeline stages, enabling chunked prefill, speculative prefill execution, and a lightweight kernel scheduler that better coordinates KV cache lifetimes and continuous batching. This PR implements: 1) chunked prefill path that breaks long prefill requests into controlled prefill chunks to expose parallelism without blowing up memory; 2) speculative prefill that launches downstream decode kernels earlier using predicted next-token shapes to reduce idle GPU time; 3) stage-overlap orchestration which overlaps prefill compute, KV cache materialization, and early decode work where safe; 4) a kernel scheduler heuristic that prioritizes short-latency decode slices while batching longer prefill chunks; 5) KV cache reference-counting improvements to avoid premature eviction during overlap windows; 6) continuous batching integration points so the runtime can opportunistically merge small speculative decode slices with unrelated incoming requests. Design notes: the chunked prefill is controlled with a new config prefill.chunk_size and max_concurrent_prefill_chunks per device. Speculative prefill runs with a bounded prediction horizon and falls back deterministically when mismatch occurs. Stage overlap is guarded by safety checks (model compatibility table) and a new runtime flag overlap.enabled per deployment. The kernel scheduler uses a three-tier priority: hot-decode-slices, speculative-decode, prefill-chunks. KV cache lifetime is extended by an overlap token credit system to prevent eviction while speculative slices are in-flight. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is identical to previous runtime unless overlap.enabled is toggled. Performance: on a mix of short-chat workloads and long-context prefill traces we observed median p95 latency reduction of 18-24% for interactive requests and a 12% net throughput increase on rtx-a100 pools when overlap.enabled and chunking tuned. Memory overhead is controlled to <6% for typical configs. Safety: speculative slices automatically validate early logits/attention shapes; on mismatch the runtime cancels speculative slice and falls back to conservative decode without observable correctness degradation (tested in end-to-end eval harness). Implementation details: changes span serving/runtime, runtime/scheduler, runtime/kvcache, and tests/perf harness. Includes microbenchmarks and a new integration test that runs 10k mixed traces to assert no correctness regressions and measurable perf gain. See commit list for details. Related: ENG-3124 (prefill pipeline refactor), ENG-3190 (kernel scheduler work).

review_comments: Daniel Kim (request changes): Can we avoid extending KV cache lifetime unboundedly? Suggest token-crediting approach instead of naive refcount bump. -- Asha: implemented token credit system and added metrics to detect skew.

Priya Singh (comment): Nice surface area for ops tuning; please surface chunk_size and max_concurrent_prefill_chunks in console. -- Asha: added runtime.toml mapping and docs page with recommendations.

Liam O'Connor (approve): Verified integration test and microbenchmarks; scheduling heuristic seems stable on A100 clusters. Left a minor nit about metric names. -- Asha: renamed metrics to follow conventions and pushed fix.
QA (comment): Flaky test observed on smaller GPUs due to memory pressure; added guard to disable overlap when free_memory < threshold. -- Asha: added guard and test coverage for low-memory paths.
merge_summary: Squash-merged after approvals and CI green. Rollout plan: staged enablement via runtime flag; Ops to run perf validation on Dedicated pools before enabling in production. Backout: toggle overlap.enabled=false and restart runtime to return to conservative path.
release_notes: Performance: Add chunked prefill, speculative prefill, and stage-overlap kernel scheduling to improve interactive latency and net throughput. Ops: new runtime flags prefill.chunk_size, prefill.max_concurrent_prefill_chunks, overlap.enabled. Safety: speculative decode includes validation and auto-fallback on mismatch.
notes_for_ops: Default is opt-in. Start with prefill.chunk_size=256 and max_concurrent_prefill_chunks=2 on A100 pools. Monitor metric prefill_decode.speculative_fallback_rate and kvcache.overlap_active_tokens; if fallback_rate > 2% reduce speculative horizon or disable overlap.
